title: Hepatoprotective effect of total flavonoids from Carthamus tinctorius L. leaves against carbon tetrachloride-induced chronic liver injury in mice.
authors: Ma, Mengge; Chen, Lin; Tang, Zhishu; Song, Zhongxing; Kong, Xin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究红花叶片总黄酮对小鼠慢性肝损伤的保护作用，涉及分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Carthamus tinctorius L. leaves, a waste product after Carthami flos production, are rich in flavonoids. Total flavonoids from C. tinctorius L. leaves (TFCTLL) exhibited the protective effect on acute liver injury in mice in previous studies. The aim of the present study was to evaluate the hepatoprotective effect of TFCTLL on chronic liver injury (CLI) and investigate the underlying mechanism. The chemical components of TFCTLL were identified by UPLC-Q-TOF/MS, and their migration into blood was evaluated. The protective effect of TFCTLL on CLI was evaluated by antioxidative and anti-inflammatory experiments in vitro, network pharmacology and a carbon tetrachloride (CCl(4))-induced CLI mouse model. We indentified 18 chemical components in the TFCTLL samples and 4 components in plasma. TFCTLL showed significant anti-inflammatory activity and antioxidant capacity in vitro and in vivo. TFCTLL administration prominently improved the liver function and structure, decreased the mRNA expression levels of TLR2, TLR3, TLR4, NF-kappaB p65, IRF3, AKT1, TRIF, PI3K, MyD88, IL-1beta and TNF-alpha and inhibited the protein expression and nuclear translocation of NF-kappaB p65 in mice with CLI. The molecular docking results showed that components in plasma had high binding affinity for the targets TLR4, PI3K and AKT1. Therefore, TFCTLL has a protective effect against CCl(4)-induced CLI, and the underlying mechanisms may be related to antioxidation, anti-inflammation and modulation of the TLRs/NF-kappaB and PI3K/AKT pathways.
abstract_zh: 红花（Carthamus tinctorius L.）叶片是红花花（Carthami flos）生产后的废弃物，富含黄酮类化合物。前期研究表明，红花叶片总黄酮（TFCTLL）对小鼠急性肝损伤具有保护作用。本研究旨在评估TFCTLL对慢性肝损伤（CLI）的保肝作用，并探讨其潜在机制。通过UPLC-Q-TOF/MS鉴定了TFCTLL的化学成分，并评估了其向血液中的迁移情况。通过体外抗氧化和抗炎实验、网络药理学以及四氯化碳（CCl(4)）诱导的CLI小鼠模型，评估了TFCTLL对CLI的保护作用。我们在TFCTLL样品中鉴定出18种化学成分，在血浆中鉴定出4种成分。TFCTLL在体外和体内均表现出显著的抗炎活性和抗氧化能力。TFCTLL给药显著改善了肝功能和结构，降低了TLR2、TLR3、TLR4、NF-kappaB p65、IRF3、AKT1、TRIF、PI3K、MyD88、IL-1beta和TNF-alpha的mRNA表达水平，并抑制了CLI小鼠中NF-kappaB p65的蛋白表达和核转位。分子对接结果显示，血浆中的成分与靶点TLR4、PI3K和AKT1具有高结合亲和力。因此，TFCTLL对CCl(4)诱导的CLI具有保护作用，其潜在机制可能与抗氧化、抗炎以及调节TLRs/NF-kappaB和PI3K/AKT通路有关。
